summary: Summit cabin on Lassen Peak: the register dates it to 1912, 1913 newspapers and local history point to 1913; destroyed in the 1914 eruptions.

facts.design: Wood ground cabin, Region 5 GDN plan; the register gives 12 ft 8 in square, 1913 newspapers give a planned 10 by 10 feet

staffing.status: W.H. Packard of Woodland named as the occupant; accounts differ on how many seasons

facts.status_note: The cabin was destroyed in the 1914 eruptions and was never rebuilt.

access.note: The summit is inside Lassen Volcanic National Park and reached by trail. No source we read describes the cabin site today.

visit.trail_note: Trail starts at the peak parking area and runs 2.5 miles one way to the summit (1981 trail record, may be out of date); vehicle pass required

facts.agency: National Park Service - Lassen Volcanic National Park

events.note: Register date. 1913 newspapers and local history point to 1913 construction; a 1912 first attempt reportedly did not function
Summit house packed up the mountain in June 1913; a December report says it was built that summer
Destroyed in the 1914 eruptions. Sources give June (newspapers), September (local history) and summer (register)

corrections.why: June and December 1913 newspapers describe the summit house being packed up and built that summer. The register's 1912 date is contradicted, though local history says a 1912 attempt failed. For editor review.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: 1912 is the register's date and may refer to a first attempt that did not function; 1913 is when reports describe the summit house being hauled up and built.

notes_for_editor: Unresolved: build year 1912 (register) vs 1913 (1913 newspapers, local history); loss date June (1914 newspapers) vs summer (register) vs September 13 (local history); cabin size 12 ft 8 in (register) vs planned 10 by 10 ft (1913 newspapers) vs 10 ft by 6 ft (local history); occupant W.H. Packard (local history) vs Marshall M.F. Packer (1920 obituary), not known to be the same man. The record's 1912 is proposed for correction to 1913. The Lassen Historical Society post on susanvillestuff.com returned HTTP 403 and the NPS Facebook post returned no text, so neither was used. The trail record is a 1981 NRT application. No photos added. Confidence medium: no source describes the summit site today.
